app.name: Home Utilities
app.tagline: Bills in, totals out, everyone knows their share.

hints.householdName: Shown at the top of every screen and on the wall display.
hints.splitMode: You can change this later in Settings.
hints.fiscalYearStartMonth: Annual totals run from this month. July for an Australian financial year, January for a calendar year.
hints.pin: 4–8 digits. Used to log in on any device.
hints.activeFrom: Bills before this date won’t include you. A rough date is fine.

shared.label: Shared house
shared.body: Split each bill between housemates and track who has paid.

single.label: Single household
single.body: Just track totals and trends. No splitting.

home.phaseNote: The full dashboard with monthly totals, your share, upcoming bills and trends arrives in Phase 2. Bills, services and members are ready to use now.

bills.title: Bills
bills.deleteConfirm: Delete this bill and its shares? This cannot be undone.

empty.title: No bills yet
empty.body: Add your first bill by hand, or wait for the mailbox to pick one up once ingestion is set up.
empty.noServices: Create a service first, then add bills against it.

shares.title: Shares
shares.payerNote: {name} pays the provider; everyone else pays {name} back.
shares.none: No members were active during this billing period.

form.lockedNote: A housemate has already paid their share, so the amount, period and service are locked. Delete and re-enter the bill if they are wrong.
form.externalRefHint: Optional. Stops the same bill being added twice.

empty.title: No services yet
empty.body: A service is one thing you pay for: internet, electricity, gas, water, rent. Bills belong to services.

types.title: Service types
types.body: Built-in types cover the usual utilities. Add your own for anything else (cleaning, streaming, strata).
types.label: New type

form.name: Name
form.isActive: Active (uncheck when you cancel this service)
form.payerHint: Their own share is marked paid automatically and the others pay them back.

members.title: Members
members.singleNote: This is a single household, so bills are not split. Members can still log in.
members.deleteConfirm: Delete this member? If they already have bill shares, set a move-out date instead.

form.name: Name
form.newPinHint: Leave blank to keep the current PIN.
form.activeFromHint: Shares are pro-rated from this date.
form.activeToHint: Leave blank if they still live here.
form.splitWeightHint: Used when a service splits by weight. 1 = a normal share, 2 = double.
form.paymentDetails: How to pay this member back
form.paymentDetailsHint: Shown to housemates on bills this member pays. PayID, BSB and account, IBAN, Venmo, anything.

settings.title: Settings
settings.ownerOnly: Only the owner can change these.

hints.splitMode: Switching to single stops new bills being split. Existing shares are kept.
